title: Max FAR 300 for plots above 100 up to 250 sqm (MPD-2047 Table 7.2, row 3)
notes: Read from the gazette text layer, p.176. Same as MPD-2021 (300, mpd2021_mod_2022.res_plotted.far.100_250). effective_from is the date of S.O. 4597(E) (notified 20.08.2026); the plan states no other commencement date. Band conditions copied from the MPD-2021 row it supersedes — the two tables print the same bands.
user_caveat: MPD-2047 makes stilt parking mandatory for plots above 100 m² up to 750 m² (Other controls (vi), p.177).
